criteria.statement: The deploy workflow triggers on pushes to master, uses self-hosted edge-01 docker runner labels, minimal contents read permission, and serialized concurrency without cancellation.
The workflow builds backend and web local images tagged github-<shortsha> with the documented build arguments.
The workflow stages a release tree under /srv/data/bahia-controlplane/releases/github-<shortsha> using rsync before compose mutation.
The compose mutation helper deterministically updates only bahia, relay, web, and the release docs mount, and fails without writing when required live-compose assumptions are missing or ambiguous.
The workflow applies bahia, relay, and web services and verifies backend, relay, and web health checks from the runbook.
PSTF artifacts map acceptance criteria to verification evidence and state that durable Hive-CI artifact publishing remains out of scope under bahia-fj0z.
